concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-auth-overview]] - closed-beta product overview for ecommerce-platform and merchant-service-provider connections to Braintree merchants, authorized-action purpose, service and payment use cases, and dedicated Shared Vault and Grant API routes
warnings: Keep Braintree Auth distinct from generic payment-transaction authorization.
Preserve the ecommerce-platform or merchant-service-provider role, the connected Braintree merchant role and the collected closed-beta qualification.
Do not infer current availability, eligibility, merchant consent, granted scope, payment-method enablement, transaction success or live acceptance from this overview.
Keep configuration, Connect, payment-method, Shared Vault and Grant API behavior in their dedicated authorities rather than expanding this concept route into an implementation specification.
